tasks.title: Build the Afterthought single-file experience
tasks.outcome: A person can open afterthought.html and complete a bounded four-stage reflection flow with a faithful summary.

acceptance.verify_by: Open the file in a browser and traverse the flow

tasks.outcome: The draft survives refresh and can be intentionally erased while remaining offline.

acceptance.criterion: Draft text is restored after reload and Clear local note removes it
Artifact contains no external network dependency
